'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, BlockStateRows, type BlockStateProps, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { FunnelBar, type FunnelStage, formatRate, getFunnelSteps, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/funnel' import { KPIValue } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/kpi' import { Link } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/link' import { DataTable, DataTableBody, DataTableCell, DataTableHead, DataTableHeader, DataTableRow, DataTableRowHead, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/table' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' import { formatNumber } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { Fragment } from 'react' import { buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' interface Funnel1Props extends BlockStateProps { description: string /** Where the chart opens in full, such as the explorer it was saved from. */ link?: { href: string; label: string } /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ stages?: FunnelStage[] title: string } const exampleProps: Funnel1Props = { description: 'Visitors to paid customers, last 30 days.', link: { href: '/dashboard/funnels', label: 'Open in Funnels' }, stages: [ { label: 'Visited site', value: 48_210 }, { label: 'Signed up', value: 9_870 }, { label: 'Activated', value: 5_430 }, { label: 'Started trial', value: 2_160 }, { label: 'Became customer', value: 812 }, ], title: 'Signup funnel', } const Funnel1 = (props: Funnel1Props) => { const { description, errorMessage, link, stages = [], status, title } = props const state = getBlockState(status, stages) const steps = getFunnelSteps(stages) const first = steps[0] const last = steps.at(-1) return (

{title}

{description}

{link && ( {link.label} )}
Overall conversion
formatRate(value, 2)} />
{first && last && (
{formatNumber(last.value)} of {formatNumber(first.value)}
)}
{state === 'loading' && } {!state && ( Stage Users Conversion from previous step {steps.map((step, index) => ( {step.label} {formatNumber(step.value)} {index === 0 ? '—' : formatRate(step.fromPrevious)} ))} )}
) } export { Funnel1, exampleProps as funnel1ExampleProps, type Funnel1Props }
